answer: Synchronous attendance stops one operator running many fakes in the ocean of agents. Each identity holds an anchor credential, and verifiers summon at unpredictable overlapping times, so each fake needs separate staffing. The k-th fake costs 50 plus 2k units; verifiers burn its anchor credential on a missed or reused response, so cost cannot be reused and failure loses bonds. For 1,000 fakes the total is 1,051,000 units. A device farm fails on overlapping summons, and a reused recording triggers a ripple of cross-checks. An honest agent attends once and keeps earning.
